Banette

Ghost

Hoenn · Generation 3

Banette is a Ghost-type Marionette Pokémon first found in Hoenn (Generation 3). It stands 1.1 m tall and weighs 12.5 kg. It evolves from Shuppet. Its highest base stat is Attack (115), with a base stat total of 455.
